title: Al-Kafirun 109:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Kafirun 109:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 30. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ (١) لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ (٢) وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: I do not worship what you worship.
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Kafirun 109:1-3 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 109:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Tell a grown-up: 'I worship Allah alone.'
In 109:2 the Prophet ﷺ says: 'I do not ...
questions.a: A) worship what you worship. 109:2: 'I do not worship what you worship.'

questions.q: Al-Kafirun 109:2: «لَآ أَعْبُدُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Who is the only One we worship?
questions.a: Allah alone. Al-Kafirun teaches us to say this clearly and kindly.
